# On-device document recognition

- Tesseract.js 7.0.0 and its worker, from the npm package `tesseract.js`.
- Tesseract.js-core 7.0.0, LSTM WebAssembly build, from `tesseract.js-core`.
- English recognition data from `@tesseract.js-data/eng@1.0.0`, `4.0.0_best_int`.

These components are distributed under Apache 2.0. The package license and worker notices are included beside them.
